label: MMA8451Q Tilt + Orientation Monitor
info: Reads 3-axis acceleration from an MMA8451Q every 200 ms. A function node computes the pitch and roll angles from the acceleration vector and derives a screen-rotation label ("portrait up", "landscape left", …) from the chip's hardware orientation detector, which reports portrait/landscape and back/front without any host-side filtering. The pitch/roll values show the static gravity component shifting between the axes as the board is tilted, while the hardware label flips only when the device really passes the 45° trip angle — the contrast between the two is the point of the flow. Demonstrates a 14-bit tilt sensor with on-chip orientation detection. Adjust the measurement range (±2/±4/±8 g) and the output data rate (1.56 Hz – 800 Hz) in the device config node to match the application's dynamic range and bandwidth.

name: pitch / roll + screen rotation
